betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The wireless version of the Fluid Terminal. Deposit and withdraw fluids from the network using fluid containers, all while on the move.

Useful for remote fluid management: collecting lava from distant sources, distributing water to farms, or topping up coolant at a reactor site. Right-click with a bucket or fluid cell to interact with the network's fluid storage.

Same range and power mechanics as the other wireless terminals: depends on Wireless Boosters in the Access Point and drains the internal battery.

§ePS:§f The full wireless toolkit is Wireless Terminal, Wireless Crafting Terminal, Wireless Pattern Terminal, and this one. All four and you never need to be near your base again.
